implemented_requirements.evidence: board.js defines class Board with `this.grid` array, size, and methods `get`, `set`, `inBounds`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Initial board generation without pre‑existing matches and with at least one valid move
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.js `fillInitial()` fills the grid while avoiding three‑in‑a‑row and recursively calls itself if `hasValidMove()` is false (the method is referenced but not defined in the provided code).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Match detection (three or more in a line)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No method in board.js or elsewhere that scans the grid for runs of three or more identical candies.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Clearing matched candies and awarding points
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code that removes matched cells, updates `score`, or animates clears.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Gravity – candies fall to fill empty spaces and new candies appear at the top
implemented_requirements.evidence: No implementation of falling logic or refill after clears.
Absent; no loop that re‑checks for new matches after a fall.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring system tracking points per candy and combo bonuses
implemented_requirements.evidence: Constants.js defines POINTS_PER_CANDY and RUN_BONUS, but Game class never uses them.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Move counter or time limit enforcement
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game constructor sets `this.movesLeft = INITIAL_MOVES` and `this.timeLeft = INITIAL_TIME`; `tick()` decrements time and ends the game when time runs out.

implemented_requirements.requirement: User input handling for selecting and swapping adjacent candies
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.js contains a placeholder comment `onCellPointerDown(r, c) / onCellDrag(...) — input handling in ui?` and UI class is truncated with `...`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: HUD updates (score, moves, time, combo) and visual board rendering
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.html includes HUD elements and Game.start() calls `this.ui.buildBoard(this.board)` and `this.updateHUD()`, but `updateHUD` implementation is missing.

critical_issues: Missing match detection algorithm; no function to find runs of three or more.
No clearing, gravity, or refill logic; board never changes after a swap.
Scoring never updated because no match handling exists.
Input handling is only a comment placeholder; UI class is incomplete.
Game.js lacks core methods to process a player move, validate swaps, and trigger cascades.
References to undefined methods (e.g., `hasValidMove`) cause runtime errors.
UI rendering and animation code is omitted, making the application non‑functional.
judge.summary: The submitted code provides a skeletal board model and some game‑loop scaffolding, but it lacks the essential mechanics required for a match‑3 game: match detection, clearing, gravity, cascade handling, scoring updates, and user input processing. Consequently, the implementation cannot be executed as a playable game and fails the benchmark requirements.
